rules.name: Hardcoded secret detection
rules.description: Secrets, private keys, or API tokens must not be committed to source control.

rules.name: Literal credentials in config templates
rules.description: Example environment or configuration templates should avoid exposing realistic or literal credential values.

rules.name: Production debug mode enabled
rules.description: Debug or development modes must be disabled in production deployments to prevent sensitive error leakage.

rules.name: Insecure cookie configuration
rules.description: Cookies must be configured with Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite attributes to defend against hijacking and CSRF.

rules.name: Overly permissive CORS configuration
rules.description: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing policies should restrict origins rather than allowing wildcards with credentials.
